title: Incident rehearsal stages
method: Synthetic sequential timeline from first affected request to verified restoration: 4 + 6 + 18 + 7 = 35 minutes. Stage definitions are fixed. Parallel investigation time and post-incident analysis are excluded from this impact window.
alt: Incident rehearsal stages: Detection 4 minutes, Declare and assign 6 minutes, Mitigate 18 minutes, Verify recovery 7 minutes. Illustrative inputs.
